Practice Note for Authorised Persons,
 Buildings Department       Registered Structural Engineers and     APP-3
                             Registered Geotechnical Engineers

                    Nomination of an Authorized Person,
        Registered Structural Engineer or Registered Geotechnical Engineer
                                    to act in stead

          When an authorized person (AP), registered structural engineer (RSE) or
registered geotechnical engineer (RGE), who has been appointed in respect of building
works,  street works or minor works,  is incapacitated by  illness or proposes to be
temporarily absent from Hong Kong, a temporary replacement should be nominated by
submission of the specified form, i.e. Form BA 21 or Form MW09, within 7 days.
Sections 4(2) and 4A(5) of the Buildings Ordinance, Regulation 23(2) of the Building
(Administration) Regulations and section 49 of the Building (Minor Works) Regulation
refer.

2.           While an AP, RSE or RGE may be appointed in respect of more than one
active project [i.e. with works in progress and/or applications currently or about to be
lodged with the Buildings Department (BD)], the AP, RSE or RGE nominating a
temporary replacement should -

        (a)    complete and submit one Form BA 21 for all active building works
              or street works projects as defined above, a list of which is to be
              given in the Form to be submitted in duplicate;

        (b)     in the case of a RSE or a RGE appointed in respect of more than
             one building works or street works project under different APs,
              submit one Form BA 21 for all active projects under each AP. A
                     list of the respective projects is to be given in the Form which
              should be signed by the AP concerned;

        (c)     in  case  of  class   I  minor  works,  the  prescribed  building
               professionals (i.e. AP, RSE or RGE) shall complete and submit
             one Form MW09 for all active minor works projects;

        (d)     advise the nominee that if it is necessary for him to communicate
              with the BD in respect of any of the listed active projects he should
            on every such occasion make brief reference to the fact that he
             does so under the authority of an earlier submission of Form BA
            21 or Form MW09;

        (e)     advise  the nominee  that he  cannot  further nominate  another
           AP/RSE/RGE to act in his stead;

         (f)     advise the BD by  letter within 7 days  that the arrangements
              covered by Form BA 21 have ceased if he recovers from illness,
              or return from overseas before the expiry date of the temporary
              replacement given in the Form; and
                                                                                      /(g).   ....

- 2 -

        (g)     in case of class I minor works, the nominee should notify the BD
            by the standard form MW31 within 7 days  after the date of
               cessation of the nomination.  Section 50 of the Building (Minor
            Works) Regulation refers.

3.          Under  sections  4(2)  and  4A(5)  of  the  Buildings  Ordinance,  an
AP/RSE/RGE may nominate another AP/RSE/RGE to act in his stead ONLY under
the following circumstances :-

         (i)     the period must be temporary; AND
          (ii)    he is unable to act by reason of his illness or absence from Hong
            Kong.

4.         To avoid ambiguity and abuse of the Buildings Ordinance, the Building
Authority (BA) considers that an acting period exceeding 3 months or at frequent
intervals  is not temporary and such nomination may not be accepted by the BA.
Under  such  circumstances,  the  owner  may  be  advised  to  appoint  another
AP/RSE/RGE.

5.         Upon receipt of the Form BA 21 or Form MW09, the BD will formally
acknowledge  it with a copy to the owner or the person who arranged for the minor
works to be carried out informing him the period and reason of acting.





                                        (AU Choi-kai )
                                                       Building Authority



Ref : BD GR/CC/21
    BD GP/BORD/75

This PNAP is previously known as PNAP 14
First issue   December 1974
Last revision December 2005
This revision December 2010 (AD/Sup) – General revisions, paras. 2(c) and 2(g) added
